meta.name: Interface language
meta.description: All text, dates and number formats change at once.

meta.name: Keep open when moving between blocks
meta.description: When the mouse moves from one block to another, the hover card switches to the new content.

meta.name: Show dates and times
meta.description: The hover card shows the created, modified and accessed times.

meta.name: Show file age
meta.description: Shown as a relative time, like "2 months ago".

meta.name: Flash the window when a scan finishes in the background
meta.description: Flashes the taskbar on Windows, bounces the Dock icon on macOS, sets the urgent hint on Linux.
synonyms: 扫描结束时若窗口在后台则闪烁提醒

meta.name: Open the log panel on new events
meta.description: Opens the log panel on a warning or an error. The same setting as the switch in the log panel.
synonyms: 有新事件时自动打开日志面板

meta.name: Log scan warnings
meta.description: For example "Can't access …: Access denied".

meta.name: Check for updates automatically
meta.description: At most once a day, it only reads this project's release list on GitHub and sends no usage data; small updates only show a badge at the top right

meta.name: Download updates automatically
meta.description: A new version is downloaded and checked in the background. It is installed only when you click Seamless update or the other way in the update card, never by itself.

meta.name: Versions to offer
meta.description: Previews are the releases marked as pre-release on GitHub

meta.name: Theme
meta.description: With Match system, the theme follows your system's light or dark setting.

meta.name: Accent color
meta.description: Used by primary buttons, the current navigation item, switches, sliders and focus rings.

meta.name: Reduce motion
meta.description: When on, zooming switches at once and the stripes stand still while scanning.

meta.name: Level contrast
meta.description: How much the shade differs between neighboring levels (flat ↔ deep).

meta.name: Border contrast
meta.description: How strong block borders are (soft ↔ sharp).

meta.name: Highlight halo levels
meta.description: How many ancestor title bars light up on hover or selection (subtle ↔ vivid).

meta.name: Hover highlight
meta.description: The block under the mouse gets an inner outline (white in the dark theme, near-black in the light one).

meta.name: Mouse trail
meta.description: Blocks the mouse passes over fade out.

meta.name: Recycle Bin effect
meta.description: What lies in the Recycle Bin / Trash is shaded and hatched inside a dashed outline, and the bin itself says how much emptying it frees. "Moving": the dashes march and a band of light sweeps across now and then (still with "Reduce motion")

meta.name: Selection shadow
meta.description: The selected block casts a shadow, so it is easier to follow.

meta.name: Default treemap coloring
meta.description: The same choice as the coloring buttons on the toolbar.

meta.name: Default visualization for new views
meta.description: The same choice as the visualization buttons on the toolbar.

meta.name: Default coloring for flame graphs and polar flame graphs
meta.description: Used when a new view switches to the flame graph or the polar flame graph.
synonyms: 火焰图和火焰-极坐标图默认配色

meta.name: Font size
meta.description: Title bar, bar and ring heights and the size at which labels appear scale with the font size.

meta.name: Minimum block size
meta.description: Blocks smaller than this are merged into an "N small items" block.

meta.name: Block proportions
meta.description: Treemap only. Taller ↔ wider. 0 keeps blocks as square as possible.

meta.name: Initial detail level
meta.description: The detail level new views start with, the same as the level control on the toolbar.

meta.name: Show free space in new views
meta.description: Shows the free space block in whole-volume views.

meta.name: Show unknown space in new views
meta.description: Shows the unknown space block in whole-volume views.

meta.name: Show the Recycle Bin in new views
meta.description: Draws the Recycle Bin / Trash when the scan holds one. Off: the bin takes no room and the other blocks grow to fill the view

meta.name: Sort by size
meta.description: Larger blocks go to the top left within a folder.

meta.name: Flame graph direction
meta.description: Which side the root bar is on.

meta.name: Zoom animation duration
meta.description: How long the transition takes when you double-click to zoom in or go back. 0 turns it off.

meta.name: Animation frame rate
meta.description: How often animations redraw.

meta.name: Rearrange while zooming (DynaZoom)
meta.description: Blocks are rearranged live while zooming.

meta.name: Adapt the frame rate to interaction (DynaSmooth)
meta.description: Uses a high frame rate only while you interact, which saves power.

meta.name: Flash changed blocks
meta.description: Blocks flash while scanning or when their files change.

meta.name: Default scan method
meta.description: Auto and Quick MFT: a whole NTFS volume gets an MFT quick scan (asking once for administrator rights when needed, a full scan if refused), every other location a full scan.

meta.name: Ask for administrator rights when needed
meta.description: Only the read-only scan helper is elevated, never the app itself. When off, a full scan is used without administrator rights.
synonyms: 需要时请求管理员权限

meta.group_note: Limits the disk read load a scan may cause.
meta.name: Default for manual scans
meta.description: Scans started from the start page, and rescans.

meta.group_note: Limits the disk read load a scan may cause.
meta.name: Default for incremental rescans
meta.description: Targeted rescans after live monitoring sees a change.
meta.reason: Not wired up yet: live monitoring's targeted rescans don't use this level.

meta.group_note: Limits the disk read load a scan may cause.
meta.name: Custom limit
meta.description: Used when the "Custom" level is chosen.

meta.group_note: Limits the disk read load a scan may cause.
meta.name: Use low I/O priority when idle
meta.description: The "Idle" level uses the low I/O priority and leaves the disk to the apps you are using.
synonyms: 空闲时使用系统低 I/O 优先级

meta.group_note: Limits the disk read load a scan may cause.
meta.name: Give way when the disk is busy
meta.description: When other programs push the whole disk past the limit, the scan slows down to a minimum.

meta.group_note: Limits the disk read load a scan may cause.
meta.name: Maximum concurrency
meta.description: Auto: chosen from the number of processor cores. Manual: the number below.

meta.group_note: Limits the disk read load a scan may cause.
meta.name: Manual concurrency
meta.description: In manual mode, how many folders are listed at the same time at most (worker processes when the native extension is missing).

meta.name: Scan NTFS alternate data streams
meta.description: Counts the hidden data streams attached to files in their size during an MFT quick scan (a full scan doesn't read streams).
synonyms: 扫描 NTFS 备用数据流

meta.name: Cross mount points
meta.description: Goes into other volumes mounted in folders. When off, only the current volume is counted.

meta.name: Protected places
meta.description: Without Full Disk Access, macOS asks one by one before the Desktop, Documents, Downloads, cloud drives, the Photos library and other apps' data can be read.

meta.name: Hard links
meta.description: Counted once, the totals match the real size on disk.

meta.name: Size units
meta.description: With 1000, 778.6 GB shows as 836.0 GB.

meta.name: Live monitoring
meta.description: Uses the USN journal and ReadDirectoryChangesEx. Changed files flash.

meta.name: Event merge interval
meta.description: Changes within this time are merged into one refresh.

meta.name: Red tag ▲
meta.description: The display name appears in the details panel and the hover card. Filters still use :red.

meta.name: Yellow tag ■
meta.description: Filters still use :yellow.

meta.name: Green tag ●
meta.description: Filters still use :green.

meta.name: Blue tag ◆
meta.description: Filters still use :blue.

meta.name: Ctrl is optional when the treemap has focus
meta.description: Press 1–4 to tag and 0 to clear.
synonyms: 树图有焦点时可省略 Ctrl

meta.name: Remember tags
meta.description: Tags are saved per scan root and come back after a rescan or when a snapshot is opened.

meta.name: Key preset
meta.description: Shows as "Custom" once any key is changed.
meta.reason: Changing keys isn't implemented yet (see TODO). The table below lists the current keys.

meta.name: Log file level
meta.description: The lowest level written to the log file.

meta.name: Save a snapshot after each scan
meta.description: Used by the recent scans on the start page and by snapshot comparison.

meta.name: Recent snapshots to keep
meta.description: Of older snapshots, one per week is kept.

meta.name: Keep large scans in mapped files
meta.description: When on, scans whose node table passes 256 MB (about two million items) go to memory-mapped files on disk and take no private memory; after the scan this writes about 200 bytes per item to disk once.

meta.name: Scan data memory limit
meta.description: Once scan data passes this share of physical memory, new node tables go to memory-mapped files on disk: they take no private commit, and the system keeps the parts in use in memory.

meta.description: Used by primary buttons, the current navigation item, switches, sliders and focus rings.

meta.name: Reduce motion
meta.description: When on, zooming switches at once and the stripes stand still while scanning.

meta.name: Level contrast
meta.description: How much the shade differs between neighboring levels (flat ↔ deep).

meta.name: Border contrast
meta.description: How strong block borders are (soft ↔ sharp).

meta.name: Highlight halo levels
meta.description: How many ancestor title bars light up on hover or selection (subtle ↔ vivid).

meta.name: Hover highlight
meta.description: The block under the mouse gets an inner outline (white in the dark theme, near-black in the light one).

meta.name: Mouse trail
meta.description: Blocks the mouse passes over fade out.

meta.name: Recycle Bin effect
meta.description: What lies in the Recycle Bin / Trash is shaded and hatched inside a dashed outline, and the bin itself says how much emptying it frees. "Moving": the dashes march and a band of light sweeps across now and then (still with "Reduce motion")

meta.name: Selection shadow
meta.description: The selected block casts a shadow, so it is easier to follow.

meta.name: Default treemap coloring
meta.description: The same choice as the coloring buttons on the toolbar.

meta.name: Default visualization for new views
meta.description: The same choice as the visualization buttons on the toolbar.

meta.name: Default coloring for flame graphs and polar flame graphs
meta.description: Used when a new view switches to the flame graph or the polar flame graph.
synonyms: 火焰图和火焰-极坐标图默认配色

meta.name: Font size
meta.description: Title bar, bar and ring heights and the size at which labels appear scale with the font size.

meta.name: Minimum block size
meta.description: Blocks smaller than this are merged into an "N small items" block.

meta.name: Block proportions
meta.description: Treemap only. Taller ↔ wider. 0 keeps blocks as square as possible.

meta.name: Initial detail level
meta.description: The detail level new views start with, the same as the level control on the toolbar.

meta.name: Show free space in new views
meta.description: Shows the free space block in whole-volume views.

meta.name: Show unknown space in new views
meta.description: Shows the unknown space block in whole-volume views.

meta.name: Show the Recycle Bin in new views
meta.description: Draws the Recycle Bin / Trash when the scan holds one. Off: the bin takes no room and the other blocks grow to fill the view

meta.name: Sort by size
meta.description: Larger blocks go to the top left within a folder.

meta.name: Flame graph direction
meta.description: Which side the root bar is on.

meta.name: Zoom animation duration
meta.description: How long the transition takes when you double-click to zoom in or go back. 0 turns it off.

meta.name: Animation frame rate
meta.description: How often animations redraw.

meta.name: Rearrange while zooming (DynaZoom)
meta.description: Blocks are rearranged live while zooming.

meta.name: Adapt the frame rate to interaction (DynaSmooth)
meta.description: Uses a high frame rate only while you interact, which saves power.

meta.name: Flash changed blocks
meta.description: Blocks flash while scanning or when their files change.

meta.name: Default scan method
meta.description: Auto and Quick MFT: a whole NTFS volume gets an MFT quick scan (asking once for administrator rights when needed, a full scan if refused), every other location a full scan.

meta.name: Ask for administrator rights when needed
meta.description: Only the read-only scan helper is elevated, never the app itself. When off, a full scan is used without administrator rights.
synonyms: 需要时请求管理员权限

meta.group_note: Limits the disk read load a scan may cause.
meta.name: Default for manual scans
meta.description: Scans started from the start page, and rescans.

meta.group_note: Limits the disk read load a scan may cause.
meta.name: Default for incremental rescans
meta.description: Targeted rescans after live monitoring sees a change.
meta.reason: Not wired up yet: live monitoring's targeted rescans don't use this level.

meta.group_note: Limits the disk read load a scan may cause.
meta.name: Custom limit
meta.description: Used when the "Custom" level is chosen.

meta.group_note: Limits the disk read load a scan may cause.
meta.name: Use low I/O priority when idle
meta.description: The "Idle" level uses the low I/O priority and leaves the disk to the apps you are using.
synonyms: 空闲时使用系统低 I/O 优先级

meta.group_note: Limits the disk read load a scan may cause.
meta.name: Give way when the disk is busy
meta.description: When other programs push the whole disk past the limit, the scan slows down to a minimum.

meta.group_note: Limits the disk read load a scan may cause.
meta.name: Maximum concurrency
meta.description: Auto: chosen from the number of processor cores. Manual: the number below.

meta.group_note: Limits the disk read load a scan may cause.
meta.name: Manual concurrency
meta.description: In manual mode, how many folders are listed at the same time at most (worker processes when the native extension is missing).

meta.name: Scan NTFS alternate data streams
meta.description: Counts the hidden data streams attached to files in their size during an MFT quick scan (a full scan doesn't read streams).
synonyms: 扫描 NTFS 备用数据流

meta.name: Cross mount points
meta.description: Goes into other volumes mounted in folders. When off, only the current volume is counted.

meta.name: Protected places
meta.description: Without Full Disk Access, macOS asks one by one before the Desktop, Documents, Downloads, cloud drives, the Photos library and other apps' data can be read.

meta.name: Hard links
meta.description: Counted once, the totals match the real size on disk.

meta.name: Size units
meta.description: With 1000, 778.6 GB shows as 836.0 GB.

meta.name: Live monitoring
meta.description: Uses the USN journal and ReadDirectoryChangesEx. Changed files flash.

meta.name: Event merge interval
meta.description: Changes within this time are merged into one refresh.

meta.name: Red tag ▲
meta.description: The display name appears in the details panel and the hover card. Filters still use :red.

meta.name: Yellow tag ■
meta.description: Filters still use :yellow.

meta.name: Green tag ●
meta.description: Filters still use :green.

meta.name: Blue tag ◆
meta.description: Filters still use :blue.

meta.name: Ctrl is optional when the treemap has focus
meta.description: Press 1–4 to tag and 0 to clear.
synonyms: 树图有焦点时可省略 Ctrl

meta.name: Remember tags
meta.description: Tags are saved per scan root and come back after a rescan or when a snapshot is opened.

meta.name: Key preset
meta.description: Shows as "Custom" once any key is changed.
meta.reason: Changing keys isn't implemented yet (see TODO). The table below lists the current keys.

meta.name: Log file level
meta.description: The lowest level written to the log file.

meta.name: Save a snapshot after each scan
meta.description: Used by the recent scans on the start page and by snapshot comparison.

meta.name: Recent snapshots to keep
meta.description: Of older snapshots, one per week is kept.

meta.name: Keep large scans in mapped files
meta.description: When on, scans whose node table passes 256 MB (about two million items) go to memory-mapped files on disk and take no private memory; after the scan this writes about 200 bytes per item to disk once.

meta.name: Scan data memory limit
meta.description: Once scan data passes this share of physical memory, new node tables go to memory-mapped files on disk: they take no private commit, and the system keeps the parts in use in memory.
